title: Fingrid documented 2025 transmission changes - chronology evidence only
source_license: Fingrid open data general CC BY 4.0; individual news pages are cited as documents, not assumed machine-readable or ODbL
scope: Dated operator statements used as screening facts, not georeferenced technical network asset geometry

events.name: Aurora Line FI-SE1 400kV
events.date_precision: operator later confirmed November 2025; 29 October press release specified expected 13 November
events.consequence: 2024 prebuilt snapshot cannot be assumed to contain energized late-2025 Aurora Line; series compensation commissioning phased

events.name: Huittinen-Forssa 400+110kV
events.date_precision: completed in Q3 2025 according to Fingrid annual accounts; earlier reports confirm before Sept 30
events.consequence: 2024 high-voltage proxy predates Q3 2025 reinforcement; also excludes 110kV alterations

events.name: Alajarvi-Lestijarvi 55 km 400kV ownership
events.date_precision: acquisition announced 29 January 2025; exact transfer date not specified
events.consequence: Ownership transfer is not a new physical 2025 line; existence in Sep 2024 OSM is unknown until identified

events.name: EstLink 2 FI-EE HVDC restored
events.date_precision: 20 June 2025 according to Fingrid half-year report
events.consequence: Link existence and operational availability differ: damaged 25 Dec 2024; restored to commercial use 20 Jun 2025; HVDC needs separate model and published availability

events.name: Lowlands Line Alajarvi-Hausjarvi future reinforced 400kV
events.date_precision: operator forecast completion during 2028–2029; not an observed energization date
events.consequence: Do not insert this forecast 400-kV reinforcement into 2025 physical simulations

nonclaims: No original OSM line ID matched to any operator-identified asset
No operator as-built bus or full branch table available in these cited statements
No line r/x/b, thermal MVA, 2025 dispatch, actual switching or physical grid N-1 inferred
Calendar windows are conservative uncertainty bounds, not exact switching events unless separately stated
